name: Julius Leonidas
bio: Julius Leonidas is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XII: 20.

poems.title: Book XII, 20
poems.author: Julius Leonidas
poems.text: Zeus is again rejoicing in the banquets of the Ethiopians, or, turned to gold, hath stolen to Danae’s chamber ; for it is a marvel that, seeing Periander, he did not carry off from Earth the lovely youth ; or is the god no longer a lover of boys?
